messages:
rachel_pm: Customer 'Nimbus' asked for a one-pane Console view that ties feature-level spend to error spikes and deploy events. Need to scope MVP and acceptance criteria for Q2 delivery.

diego_back: Clarify 'feature-level' mapping: do they mean a single route or business feature that may hit multiple routes? If multi-route, we need a mapping CSV or heuristics.

anya_ui: UX thought: start with a simple flow: select customer -> select feature (free-text + mapping) -> see a compact dashboard: cost trend, error rate, deploy markers, and an Investigate button. Keep the first screen readable for execs.

rachel_pm: We'll require Nimbus to provide feature->route mapping for beta. That keeps instrumentation changes minimal.

kevin_sre: Telemetry changes needed: optional feature_tag in request envelope, token counts, model_id, and a price_id snapshot at ingest. No full payload capture initially. On-demand trace fetch only.

telemetry-bot: Proposed flag created: feature_spend_beta. Default off. Runbook placeholder for on-demand trace quota added.

diego_back: Cost formula: cost_usd = (tokens_in + tokens_out) * unit_price_at_ingest. We'll annotate events with price_id to avoid expensive joins at query time.

anya_ui: Acceptance criteria draft:
- Nimbus can filter by their supplied feature list and view cost/day + error-rate/day for last 30 days.
- Deploy events are plotted on the timeline.
- Clicking an error spike lets the user request up to 5 on-demand traces (counts against org quota).
- CSV export includes: feature, date, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_id, price_id, unit_price_usd, cost_usd, error_count, p95_latency_ms.

kevin_sre: Safety guards: per-org quota for trace fetches, TTL 30d for stored traces, compression enabled, and auto-disable sampling if ingestion CPU delta >3% baseline. Alert to #eng-oncall.

diego_back: Implementation note: adding feature_tag is low-overhead if optional. We'll provide a SDK change and keep it opt-in per org.

rachel_pm: Timeline: if Nimbus provides mapping within 2 weeks, Phase 0 (ingest + aggregated UI) could ship as a gated beta in ~5 weeks. On-demand traces Phase 1 in Q3 after perf signoff.

anya_ui: I'll mock the one-pane view and the micro-overlay that explains "why cost changed" (token delta vs price change vs volume) by Friday.

kevin_sre: I'll draft the alert/playbook and the auto-disable runbook. telemetry-bot: add alert "feature_spend_ingest_cpu_delta" threshold 3%.

telemetry-bot: Alert created and runbook stub linked to flag.

rachel_pm: Owners & next steps: @rachel_pm (Nimbus liaison + acceptance), @diego_back (ingest + price snapshot), @anya_ui (mockups + export), @kevin_sre (guardrails + alerts), @telemetry-bot (flags). I'll file product ticket and set milestone to Q2 beta. Closing thread unless blockers.
